text:
Anna (PM): Hey team — executive at VantageGrid asked for a greenlight on the POC this week. They need two things: final pricing sketch for a 3-week pilot, and confirmation we can support an allowlist + KMS BYOK flow.

Raj (Sales): They pushed legal timelines — CFO wants costs & egress exposure clarified before EOD Wed. Can we get a ballpark with commit discounts?

Mike (SE): For the pilot I'd recommend Dedicated small pool (2x A100 equiv) with autoscale to 4 for peak test. Rough estimate: hosted rates * 0.85 for a short reserved commit + pilot discount. I’ll draft numbers.

Jordan (RevOps): FYI pricing floor for pilots is 15% off list for deals < $75k ARR. For execs we can do one-time credit on overage instead of deeper discounts. Raj, want me to prepare a spreadsheet?

Raj (Sales): Yes please — simple line items: infra commit, support, KMS integration effort. Also flag any non-recurring eng hours.

Rita (Eng): Quick tech block: customer requires egress peering and an on-prem HSM for keys (BYOK). Our Private deployment supports HSM but ops needs a week to provision and test. Also, we need IPs for allowlist.

Emily (CISO): We can sign off on BYOK provided KMS attestation & HSM compliance doc (FIPS 140-2/3). Raj — can you send their security questionnaire? We’ll triage gaps.

Raj (Sales): Sent the questionnaire earlier, they added a follow-up on data retention and lineage. Attaching answers in thread.

Anna (PM): Action items: 1) Mike + Rita: feasibility + ETA for HSM & allowlist (target: 48h) 2) Jordan: pricing spreadsheet 3) Emily: security checklist + gap list 4) Raj: keep exec updated.

Mike (SE): Ack. For allowlist we need these IPs whitelisted on their firewall: 34.82.123.45, 34.82.123.46, 34.82.123.47. Also will need port 443 outbound and webhooks on 443 inbound to our callback subdomain. Example snippet for IT:```txt
Source                         Destination               Ports
VantageGrid FW                redwood-api.us-east-1     443
VantageGrid FW                34.82.123.45/32           443
```

Rita (Eng): ETA: baseline Private deploy with HSM test in 72h if infra approval today. If they want on-prem airgapped option that adds 2-3 weeks.

Jordan (RevOps): Pricing sheet uploaded: https://redwood.internal/drive/poc-vantagegrid. I put two scenarios: 3-week pilot (no commit) and 3-week reserved (small commit). Comments column lists potential credits.

Emily (CISO): I reviewed their answers — two items flagged: 1) key rotation cadence is not documented on their side, need confirmation 2) they use third-party analytics that may pull logs — need confirmation on PII handling. If both are clarified, security can approve pilot.

Raj (Sales): On call with their CTO at 3pm PT. I'll push the BYOK attestation and ask about analytics.

Anna (PM): Exec asked for a one-page status note for the 4pm sync. Can someone draft bullet summary?

Mike (SE): Drafting now — will post in 10.

Mike (SE): (posted) "Status: Ready to provision Private pilot; infra ETA 72h pending approvals. Risks: HSM provisioning timeline, unanswered questions on their analytics/PII, IP allowlist pending. Next steps: RevOps to finalize pricing, CISO to sign off on security checklist."

Raj (Sales): CTO said analytics vendor is only collecting anonymized telemetry, will send SOC2 addendum. Also said their infra team can expedite firewall rules if we give the IP list.

Emily (CISO): Once SOC2 addendum arrives, I can clear the analytics point. Still need written confirmation for key rotation cadence.

Rita (Eng): Please confirm who will open the infra ticket for provisioning. I can take the assignment but need approval from infra lead @oncall.

Anna (PM): I'll open the ticket and assign to Rita + infra. Jordan — can you add the one-page status into the exec pack and cc me?

Jordan (RevOps): Done and shared with Anna.

deploy-bot: Ticket #INF-7421 created by Anna (PM) assigned to Rita (Eng). ETA set to 72 hours.

Anna (PM): Closing loop — Raj, can you confirm CFO will accept the pilot credit instead of lower list price? If yes, we can avoid lengthy approval cycles.

Raj (Sales): CFO said pilot credits OK if legal signs the pilot agreement with standard terms. Asking legal for a fast track.

Anna (PM): Perfect. I'll update the exec note after legal confirms. Thanks all :thumbsup:
